text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-4012 triggered for service=redwood-api (error rate spike). Page fired to primary oncall: @alex

pagerduty: Escalation policy 'API-P1' executed: Primary (alex) paged -> no ack after 2m -> Secondary (jamal) paged -> Manager (carol) paged.

alex: seeing the page, on it. I'm in transit to my laptop, ETA ~2m.

alex: quick check - dashboard shows 5xx rate jump from 0.2% -> 6.8% starting ~00:02 UTC. I can't hit the health endpoint from my phone, trying from home laptop.

maria: adding context: deploy to canary finished 00:00 UTC, rollout was 100% at 00:01. Telemetry shows spike aligns with rollout window.

incident-bot: Note: if primary doesn't acknowledge within 3m, escalation to manager will include SMS.

pagerduty: alex failed to acknowledge within 3m. Escalating to jamal (secondary) now.

jamal: ack INC-4012. jumping in. first pass: rolling back the 00:00 canary might stop the error. Can we confirm release id?

alex: release is release/2026-03-14-00:00 f2d9b3. I can trigger a rollback but need a hand with routing to avoid dup traffic.

carol: I'm getting SMS. If primary can't ack, I'll take owner until resolved. Carols' priority: customer impact assessment + comms.

maria: customer impact: synthetic monitors show 12% of requests failing for endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Estimated customers affected: ~120 customers, spike in errors for low-latency workloads. Marking P1.

jamal: running quick health check: 
``` 
curl -s -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.example/health || true
```
returns 502 consistently from a few nodes. Logs show Nginx upstream read timeout to model pool.

alex: logging in to the router node now. attaching logs: 
``` 
[router-12] 00:04:12 upstream_timeout target=model-pool-3 latency=30s backlog=12
[model-pool-3]OOM: worker 7 killed by OOM at 00:03:59
```

jamal: OK OOM during allocation after rollout. Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback release, 2) scale model-pool up by 2 instances, 3) flip routing to spare region. Rollback is fastest to confirm root cause.

alex: I can kick rollback. Doing: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-server --to-revision=202603140000` (will post progression).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Manager escalation (carol) notified via SMS/phone.

carol: on call escalation received. Please add a short impact blurb for external comms and I'll prepare a status page draft.

maria: impact blurb: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for the API affecting a subset of generation/embedding requests; degraded performance and failed requests observed. Engineers are actively rolling back a recent deployment. We will update within 30 minutes."

jamal: rollback initiated by alex. `kubectl rollout status deployment/api-server` shows: 2/3 pods ready -> 3/3 ready at 00:09.

alex: rollback successful. Error rate falling: dashboards show 5xx -> 0.6% within 90s.

pagerduty: INC-4012 acknowledged by jamal at 1748001290.

carol: good work. timeline notes for postmortem: triggered by deploy -> OOM in model-pool -> routing timeouts -> customer impact. Please capture which canary checks missed OOM signal.

maria: Started a temporary mitigation ticket to limit model batch size until we have a permanent fix.

jamal: I'm going to keep monitoring for 15m. I'll also run a `kubectl describe pod model-pool-3` and collect kernel OOM logs and cgroup memory stats.

alex: handing off to jamal for monitor watch. I'm out for next call but reachable if needed. @jamal please escalate to me if error rate climbs back above 3%.

jamal: will do. setting a Grafana alert threshold for 3% 5xx and a 2m evaluation window.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff recorded: alex -> jamal at 1748001400.

carol: I'll open a customer incident page and add the impact blurb + rollback summary. Once we have root cause root-cause signals and a mitigation plan, we'll schedule a postmortem.

maria: quick ask for postmortem: include exact memory footprint change from the canary and the diff in tensor batch size.

jamal: collecting logs and uploading to the incident S3: s3://redwood-incidents/2026-03-14/INC-4012/logs.tar.gz

pagerduty: Escalation summary: Primary did not ack in time -> Secondary acked and mitigated -> Manager notified and coordinated customer communications.

carol: marking incident as under control. we will keep thread open until stable for 30m. thanks everyone. :bow:
